GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.

2. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   B. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Rocks as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   B. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.

4. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

6. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   B. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   C. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   D. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   D. Treat Folding as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

13. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   B. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   D. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   D. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

16. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
